[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Anbow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Major Anbow was among a group of Imperials that escorted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sebastian Parnell]] to the [[Deathblock]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]]. On arrival at the Deathblock, Parnell ordered Anbow to interrogate the prisoner [[Erling Tredway]], a task that Anbow was very enthusiastic about.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Anbow was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi's Honor]]'' {{1st}}
